historicalImport.description: Startup-only database backfill profiles. Connections must use read-only database accounts.

legacySources.description: Node-local allowlist of sealed legacy spool directories. Select by ID through the import API; never synchronize these host paths across controllers. Changes require archiver restart.

legacyImport.description: Bounded legacy import settings, read at startup. Defaults: 256 events/pass, up to 64 writers (capped at one eighth of live event capacity), 1 MiB/file, 16 MiB/pass, 100 ms between passes. Source must be closed by its old writer before starting import.

concurrency.description: Requested legacy writers (default 64). Runtime caps this at floor(ingestQueueMaxEvents / 8), minimum 1. Requesting 128 requires at least 1024 live event capacity; effective limits are reported by import status.

intervalMs.description: Healthy-pass pacing (default 100 ms). Explicit 10 ms is opt-in for measured local capacity; failure backoff, queue limits and ACK checks remain unchanged.

inactiveBufferMax.description: Max number of events kept in-memory while waiting for the controller/GraphQL active-topics registry (default 2000). Overflow is discarded because inactive topics are not eligible for history.

inactiveBufferMaxAgeMs.description: Max age (ms) for buffered inactive-topic events before discarding them (default 300000 = 5min).

ingestQueueMaxEvents.description: Maximum active MQTT events retained in memory while QuestDB is being written (default 512). Excess events are immediately persisted to ./event_storage.

ingestQueueMaxBytes.description: Maximum combined payload size in bytes retained by the active ingest queue (default 16777216 = 16 MiB). Excess events are immediately persisted to ./event_storage.

ingestConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent QuestDB ingest operations (default 512). A single worker waits for each shared batch flush and cannot keep up with sustained MQTT traffic.

storedReplayBatchSize.description: Maximum durable event-storage files handled in one fair replay pass (default 256). Replay keeps 25% of live ingest capacity reserved for new MQTT traffic.

storedReplayIntervalMs.description: Delay in milliseconds between completed durable replay passes (default 500). Lower values drain backlogs faster but add QuestDB load.

identityEnrichmentEnabled.description: Enrich QuestDB rows with controller-issued stable entity identity evidence. Disabled by default for a backward-compatible staged rollout.

identityResolutionRetryMaxAgeMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to retain an event while exact entity identity resolution is temporarily unavailable (default 30000). After this bound the event is written in legacy form.

traceIngest.description: Enable ingest/buffer trace logs. Equivalent to setting UNS_ARCHIVER_TRACE=1 or UNS_ARCHIVER_TRACE_INGEST=1.

configurationString.description: Legacy QuestDB ILP connection string. Prefer url, username, and password for production secrets.

url.description: QuestDB HTTP endpoint used with the structured credential form (for example https://questdb.example:9000).

batch.description: Bounded shared QuestDB ILP batching settings.

flushIntervalMs.description: Maximum time a completed ILP row waits before a shared QuestDB flush (default 1000ms).

maxRows.description: Number of ILP rows that trigger an immediate shared QuestDB flush (default 512).

maxPendingRows.description: Maximum accepted ILP rows across the queued and flushing shared sender batch (default 2048). A full queue rejects new writes so the archiver can persist them to event storage.

excludeTopics.description: MQTT topic exclusions for NEW incoming events only (for example example/maintenance/#). Takes precedence over every dataStorage include. An empty list excludes nothing. Reloaded with normal config refresh. Accepted queues, journal/legacy replay and existing database rows remain unchanged; use target pause to stop pending writes.

tablePrefix.description: Prefix used when naming QuestDB tables for this topic

topic.description: UNS topic filter subscribed for ingestion

ingestMode.description: Default ingestion mode: append (default), dedup (upsert on eventId), or window_replace. Note: QuestDB has no row-level DELETE; window_replace is implemented as soft delete (sets deleted=true for rows in the window that were not refreshed).

ingestModeData.description: Optional override of ingestMode for data messages

ingestModeTable.description: Optional override of ingestMode for table messages

ingestMode.description: Ingestion mode override for this dataGroup
